lines.cap: Death had his yearly performance review. It did not go well.
lines.say: Death had his yearly performance review. It did not go well.

lines.cap: Your numbers are down. Way down. What happened?
lines.say: Your numbers are down. Way down. What happened?

lines.cap: There's this Nani. I went for her in March. I'm still there.
lines.say: There's this Nani. I went for her in March. I'm still there.

lines.cap: One grandmother ruined the entire quarter?
lines.say: One grandmother ruined the entire quarter?

lines.cap: You don't understand. She makes pakoras.
lines.say: You don't understand. She makes pakoras.

lines.cap: So the boss goes to see this Nani himself. To fix it.
lines.say: So the boss goes to see this Nani himself. To fix it.

lines.cap: Arre, two of you now? Sit, sit. You're both so thin.
lines.say: Arre, two of you now? Sit, sit. You're both so thin.
lines.bubble: TWO OF YOU NOW? SIT, SIT. 🫖

lines.cap: An hour later. The boss comes back. With a tiffin.
lines.say: An hour later. The boss comes back. With a tiffin.

lines.cap: New policy. We leave that house alone.

lines.bubble: NEW POLICY: LEAVE THAT HOUSE ALONE. 🍱
